messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-4977 — hosted-inference: high error rate detected for v2 endpoint. Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> manager.

pagerduty-bot: A page was sent to bob-oncall (primary). No ack after 2m, escalating to alice.sre (secondary). Duplicate page suppression was not applied due to recent rate-limiter rule change.

bob-oncall: seeing 503 spikes on /v2/generate, confirmed from Prometheus query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"hosted-inference\",status=\"503\"}[1m]))` up ~120% vs baseline.

alice.sre: getting paged twice, looks like duplicate PD triggers. I'm pinging infra to see if the dedupe rule glitched.

sam-infra: ack — investigating PD webhook -> alertmanager path. I can see two webhook deliveries at 2026-03-15T04:12:07Z and 04:12:08Z. Downstream dedupe service returned 429 for the second delivery. Seems the rate-limiter retried in front of the dedupe service.

jen-support: thumbs up. Is there any active customer impact? Support queue has two customers reporting timeouts in the last 3m.

dave-product: Getting CS notes: some customers saw 30s+ latency, a few got 503s. Probable user-visible degradation for model generation flows.

alice.sre: mitigation plan: 1) silence alert flood (manual PD silence + incidentbot silence), 2) scale dedicated pool for v2 to absorb traffic, 3) roll back recent rate-limiter change if correlated.

bob-oncall: on it — manual PD ack to stop escalations. `pagerduty-bot acknowledge INC-4977 --user bob-oncall`

pagerduty-bot: bob-oncall acknowledged INC-4977 at 04:14:50Z. Escalations paused.

alice.sre: trying to mute duplicate deliveries at the source: disabling alertmanager PD webhook for 30s (will re-enable once dedupe is healthy). Command: `kubectl patch svc alertmanager -n monitoring -p '{"spec":{"sessionAffinity":"None"}}'` (temp change).

sam-infra: rolling back rate-limiter change from yesterday to v1 configuration (feature flag off). Patch applied. Confirming: feature-flag-rate-limiter -> off.

incident-bot: System note: automatic silence applied for duplicate alerts for 60s to reduce noise.

jen-support: Can we confirm customers who reported issues? I have two report IDs: CS-9812, CS-9813. They reported timeouts around 04:12Z.

dave-product: Running quick query: errors roughly 5% of requests to v2 over 04:10-04:15Z, spike correlates with rollout of rate-limiter change. Likely root cause.

bob-oncall: I've spun up 2 extra dedicated workers for v2: `infra scale --pool v2-dedicated --replicas +2`. Monitoring now.

alice.sre: Good. Once traffic drains to dedicated nodes we'll see error rate drop. Also please keep PD from auto-escalating to manager while we stabilize.

carla-manager: I'm on call and available if escalation needed. Please ping me if it's going to hit customer SLAs or if we need to open an incident bridge.

alice.sre: thanks Carla. current plan: stabilize -> confirm error rate <1% for 10m -> postmortem if root cause is rollout process.

sam-infra: dedupe service logs show 429 -> retry -> duplicate PD event creation. I've implemented a quick fix: reject retries with identical dedupe_key for 120s. Deploying now.

incident-bot: System note: dedupe gate updated; duplicates should stop.

bob-oncall: errors dropping — 503s down to baseline ~0.4% at 04:22Z after scaling and rollback.

jen-support: letting affected customers know we've mitigated; tracking CS tickets.

dave-product: tagging this as minor customer impact, some timed out requests, no data loss. Will coordinate postmortem scope.

alice.sre: final checks: keep alert un-silenced when ready, re-enable webhook once dedupe gate is confirmed stable. I'll hold for 10m observation then clear the incident.

carla-manager: thanks all — appreciate the quick coordination. If anything flares, please escalate to me immediately. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Thread closed for now — monitoring continues. Add notes: rollback rate-limiter, scale v2-dedicated +2, dedupe gate patch applied.

(End of thread)
